name: Yahoo Finance
description: For each record, loads the price history of the ticker in a field from Yahoo Finance: open, high, low, close, volume, dividends and splits per day, week, month or shorter interval, between two dates.
introductoryText:
![](data:image/png;base64,)

For each record of the input, loads the **price history** of its ticker symbol from Yahoo Finance (through the open-source yfinance library) and writes one record per period: the input record's fields, then Date, Open, High, Low, Close, Volume, Dividends and Stock Splits.

**How to set it up**
1. Choose the field that holds the ticker symbols, as Yahoo Finance writes them (`AAPL`, `VOD.L` for London, `BMW.DE` for Frankfurt, `^FTSE` for an index).
2. Enter the start date and, optionally, the end date (YYYY-MM-DD; the end date is not included; empty means up to today).
3. Choose the interval.

Prices are adjusted for splits and dividends. Daily and longer bars carry the exchange's own date; intraday times are in UTC. yfinance is not an official Yahoo interface and may change; its documentation says the data is intended for personal use (see Yahoo's terms).

options.name: Ticker
options.title: Ticker field
options.description: The field with the ticker symbols, as Yahoo Finance writes them (VOD.L, BMW.DE, ^FTSE). Each distinct symbol is downloaded once; every record with it gets its prices.

options.name: End
options.title: End date
options.description: The day after the last one, written YYYY-MM-DD (not included). Empty: up to today.

options.name: Interval
options.title: Interval
options.description: One record per this period. Intraday intervals (1 hour and shorter) only reach back about 60 days (1 hour: about two years).

blockOutputs.label: Prices
blockOutputs.tooltip: Each input record repeated for every period of its ticker, with Date (or Datetime for intraday), Open, High, Low, Close, Volume, Dividends, Stock Splits.
